The '''2017–18 [[Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 1]]''' is the 59th season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in [[Ivory Coast|Côte d'Ivoire]]. The season began on 14 October 2017 and ended on 3 June 2018.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ivo2018.html Ivory Coast 2017/18], RSSSF.com</ref>
